messages:
Hannah Li: Quick alert 10 renewal-risk counts spiked for Enterprise accounts this morning. Anyone else seeing this?
Rafael Gomez: Yep saw the dashboard jump. Looks like a change in the CRM dedupe webhook landed last night.
Ava (CS Ops): We rolled the dedupe patch to prevent duplicate contacts from creating parallel account records. But the merge path currently drops the 'renewal_contacted' custom field unless it's the retained record.
Hannah Li: That would explain it  some accounts lost the +15 renewal_contacted signal and moved into at-risk.
Rafael Gomez: Immediate plan: 1) backfill lost renewal_contacted flags from merge audit logs, 2) patch merge workflow to preserve custom fields, 3) add a CI check to simulate merges and assert field preservation.
Ava (CS Ops): I can build the backfill. SQL to locate affected accounts:
```
SELECT m.source_account_id, m.target_account_id, a.custom_fields->>'renewal_contacted' as renewal_flag
FROM merge_audit m
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = m.source_account_id
WHERE m.created_at >= '2026-03-10' AND a.custom_fields ? 'renewal_contacted';
```
We'll emit an idempotent event: event_type = 'restore_renewal_flag' with id = sha1(account_id || '-restore-202603').
renewal-bot: Noted. Creating task renewals/merge-flag-restore. Tagging @Hannah for review.
Hannah Li: Also want to avoid surprising CSMs. Ava, include an automated account note and a short CSV of affected accounts for the CSM queue.
Ava (CS Ops): Will attach note template: "Automated restoration of renewal_contacted flag due to CRM merge. See internal playbook for details." and queue to #csm-notifications.
Rafael Gomez: For the merge workflow patch, I'll add a compatibility layer: when merging, copy known custom fields (renewal_contacted, renewal_owner_id, next_renewal_date) to the target if present. Add unit tests.
Hannah Li: Acceptance criteria for backfill: net reduction in renewal-risk <= 1% for Enterprise cohort; audit log entries for every restored flag; CSM notes attached. Also run a 90-day sim to ensure no over-restores.
Ava (CS Ops): Timeline: staging backfill tonight, review tomorrow morning, prod backfill in a maintenance window.
playbook-bot: Created playbook task cs/renewal/merge-restore (#88). Backfill queued -> staging.
Ava (CS Ops): Staging run summary: processed 312 merges, restored renewal flag for 278 accounts, 34 skipped (no flag present).
Hannah Li: Nice. Can you post health delta after staging run?
Ava (CS Ops): Staging health counts pre/after: ["on_track": 982 -> 1005, "at_risk": 124 -> 101, "renewal_pending": 45 -> 45].
Rafael Gomez: Looks good. I'll merge the merge-workflow patch after CI. Also adding a simulate-merges integration test to the infra suite.
Ava (CS Ops): Scheduling prod backfill for 2026-03-18T02:00Z with throttle 10/s and idempotency. CSV of affected accounts uploaded to /ops/cs/restore-reports/20260318.csv.
Hannah Li: Thanks. After prod backfill, let's run a retrospective to see if any renewals were accidentally advanced. If anything odd, we'll roll back.
renewal-bot: Prod backfill completed: processed 308 merges, restored 275 flags, 33 skipped. Audit events created for each restore.
Ava (CS Ops): Prod health delta: on_track +22, at_risk -21. CSM broadcast sent with attached CSV and FAQ.
Hannah Li: Good work. Follow-ups: Rafael please add the merge-preserve test to the pre-prod checklist. Also let's add a tiny monitoring alert: if custom_field loss > 0.5% after merges, trigger pager.
Rafael Gomez: Will add the test and the alert. Closing the loop.
